title: Essential Guide to Eccentric Sleeves for Indexable Drilling
summary: Learn how eccentric sleeves can enhance precision in indexable drilling operations. Discover the benefits and adjustment techniques for optimal performance.
body_markdown:
Eccentric sleeves are a valuable accessory for enhancing the precision and flexibility of indexable drills. By understanding the benefits, usage guidelines and adjustment techniques, you can optimize your drilling operations and achieve superior results. Whether you're needing to balance diameter deviations or requiring off-the-shelf drilling diameters, eccentric sleeves provide the adaptability needed for various applications.


Kennametal offers several[eccentric sleeves](https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/products/metalworking-tools/holemaking/indexable-drilling/short-hole-drilling-drill-fix-tools/drill-fix-accessories.html?query=:relevance:obsoleteFacet:false:allCategoriesKMT:63232488&sort=&pageSize=16&category=63232488&uom=inch) for Drill Fix™ PRO indexable drilling.[Click here to explore the complete Drill Fix PRO lineup](https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/products/metalworking-tools/holemaking/indexable-drilling/short-hole-drilling-drill-fix-tools/drill-fix-pro.html) .
